answer.summary: Every failing test died at Spring ApplicationContext startup, not in its own assertions. The root cause is an invalid query in PayloadIdentityRepository.findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse, a file this change touches: JSqlParser rejects the SQL at line 15, column 68 ("ANDi"). That is deterministic and will repeat on re-run, so the flake history (0 flakes) fits a real regression.
